preconditions.description: Attacker must have the owner role of the contract to be able to modify fees.

exploit_hint: The attacker, who is the contract owner, calls the `setFees_base1000` function, setting all fee parameters (`_liquidityFee`, `_marketingFee`, `_teamFee`, `_devFee`) to zero. This action updates the `totalFee` state variable to 0. As a result, any subsequent transaction by a user that triggers the `swapBack` function (e.g., selling enough tokens to meet the `swapThreshold`) will revert due to a division-by-zero error in the fee calculation logic within `swapBack`. This creates a Denial of Service (DoS) condition, preventing users from selling tokens.
